payout_quote: Get free auto-payouts after every batch: Receive auto-payouts of your earnings to your Instacart Shopper Rewards account so that you can get paid quickly after every batch-at no cost to you. Most payouts take a few minutes, but some may be subject to delays.
timing: Automatic after every completed batch; most payouts take a few minutes, some subject to delays.
eligibility: Instacart shopper enrolled in the Shopper Rewards Card program: a business debit Mastercard (via Branch; banking services by Lead Bank, Member FDIC) with no minimum balance, no credit check, and no monthly fee.
steps: Sign up for the Instacart Shopper Rewards Card (business debit Mastercard).
Complete batches as an Instacart shopper.
Earnings auto-payout to the Shopper Rewards account after every batch at no cost.
Spend with the card (usable anywhere Mastercard debit is accepted) or add it to a digital wallet; first 8 Allpoint ATM withdrawals per month are free.
catches: Auto-payouts are free today, but the official listing states Instacart may elect to charge a fee for Shopper Rewards Card payouts at any time, subject to notice.
First 8 ATM withdrawals per month at in-network Allpoint ATMs are free; after that a $3.50 fee applies per Allpoint transaction, and out-of-network ATM owner fees apply.
This is a debit card, not a credit card: it complies with the no-credit-card rule.
Batch pay varies by market and demand; fuel, maintenance, insurance and other vehicle costs reduce net earnings.
Top gas/EV cash-back rates (up to 4%) require Diamond Cart status; base rates are 1-3%.
No delivery-count promotion is quoted on the official page.
biggest_catch: The 'free' in free auto-payouts is not locked in: the official listing explicitly reserves Instacart's right to start charging a payout fee at any time with notice.

who_pays: Instacart auto-pays your batch earnings to your Shopper Rewards account after every completed batch - a business debit Mastercard issued through Branch, with banking services by Lead Bank, Member FDIC. It is your shopper earnings paid directly by Instacart, not a third party.
who_qualifies: You need to be an active Instacart shopper enrolled in the Shopper Rewards Card program - no minimum balance, no credit check, and no monthly fee. To shop at all, Instacart requires you to be 18 or older, eligible to work in the US, able to lift 30-40 lbs, and - for full-service delivery shoppers - to have a vehicle, a valid license, insurance, and pass a background check.
work_available: Batches depend on order demand in your area - the official listing states pay varies by market and promises no minimum work. Spot availability and signup waitlists vary by area and are not officially published, so nothing about your volume is guaranteed.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid for batches you complete and deliver; canceled or unfulfilled batches do not pay. Instacart publishes no exact shopper-rating threshold tied to auto-payouts in the official listing - that part is unverified.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Auto-payouts to the card are currently free, but the official listing explicitly reserves Instacart's right to start charging a payout fee with notice - so that can change. Your fuel, maintenance, and insurance come out of your pocket, cash withdrawals cost $3.50 each at Allpoint ATMs after your first 8 free per month (plus any ATM-owner fees elsewhere), and time spent waiting for batches and onboarding is unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: After every completed batch, your earnings auto-payout to the Shopper Rewards account, most within minutes, at no current cost - there is no cashout button to press. Spend with the card anywhere Mastercard debit is accepted, add it to a digital wallet, or withdraw cash (first 8 Allpoint ATM withdrawals per month are free, then $3.50 each).
